title: Keypad Lock Access History
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lock:access
| stats count as unlocks, values(method) as methods by user door
| sort - unlocks
description: Summarises who unlocked each door and how, from codes to app to key, giving a clear picture of household and guest access.
value: A per-user unlock history spots an unexpected code use and confirms a guest or contractor came and went as planned.
implementation: Ingest smart-lock access logs; schedule daily and review unlocks by user, door, and method.
visualization: Table of unlock counts by user and door with methods used.
grandmaExplanation: It shows who unlocked each door and how, so you can keep an eye on who is coming and going.
